name: Xanthic-Rift
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by a subterranean ocean. Beyond towering mountain ranges, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Surveyors date the monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
